storyline.name: An invoice, end to end
storyline.description: From a new invoice to a sent one, and the whole cycle around it.

journeys.name: Start a new invoice

journeys.name: Billing cycle

branches.name: Draft and send an invoice

branches.when: Operations reviews the draft before it is sent
